name: window_start
description: Start of the 1-minute event-time window (inclusive). Partition column.

name: trade_count
description: Trades in the window. At-least-once duplicates (about 0.006% of trades) are not removed.

name: volume
description: Sum of trade quantity in base currency.

name: quote_volume
description: Sum of price * quantity in quote currency.

name: vwap
description: Volume weighted average price: quote_volume / volume.

name: open
description: Price of the first trade by (trade time, trade id).

name: close
description: Price of the last trade by (trade time, trade id).

name: buy_volume
description: Volume where the aggressor was the buyer (is_buyer_maker = false).

name: sell_volume
description: Volume where the aggressor was the seller (is_buyer_maker = true).

name: pane_timing
description: ON_TIME: first result, emitted when the watermark passes the window end. LATE: a later replacement result (pane_index 1). In practice it is usually identical to the ON_TIME row and is emitted when the window expires, about 150 s after the window end; it differs only if a trade arrived after the first result (then trade_count is higher). Read trade_metrics_1m_latest, which keeps the latest pane per window.

name: pane_index
description: 0 for the first (ON_TIME) result of a window, 1 for the later LATE result. Higher index = later, complete replacement.
